configurations.name: pivoxreport
runtimeArgs: echo 'pivoxreport already running via launchd on :3000' && sleep infinity

configurations.name: frontend
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd frontend && npx next dev --port $PORT

configurations.name: frontend-prod
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd frontend && npx next start --port $PORT

configurations.name: frontend-prod-utc
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd frontend && TZ=UTC npx next start --port $PORT

configurations.name: frontend-real
runtimeArgs: source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && cd frontend && NEXT_PUBLIC_DEMO_MODE=0 npx next dev --port $PORT
